tools.name: elasticsearch_cluster_info
tools.description: Get the cluster name, node name, and Elasticsearch version of this cluster. Good first call to confirm the connection. API: GET /.

tools.name: elasticsearch_cluster_health
tools.description: Get cluster health status (green, yellow, red), node and shard counts, and unassigned shards. API: GET /_cluster/health.

tools.name: elasticsearch_cluster_stats
tools.description: Get cluster-wide statistics: document and store totals, node count, JVM memory, and versions. API: GET /_cluster/stats.

tools.name: elasticsearch_list_nodes
tools.description: List cluster nodes with roles, heap and disk usage, CPU, and load. API: GET /_cat/nodes (format=json).

tools.name: elasticsearch_list_indices
tools.description: List indices with health, status, document count, store size, and shard counts. Optional name pattern. API: GET /_cat/indices (format=json).

tools.name: elasticsearch_get_index
tools.description: Get an index's settings, mappings, and aliases in one call. API: GET /{index}.

tools.name: elasticsearch_get_mapping
tools.description: Get the field mappings (field names and types) of an index, alias or data stream. Read this before writing a search query. API: GET /{index}/_mapping.

tools.name: elasticsearch_list_aliases
tools.description: List index aliases and the indices they point to. API: GET /_alias or GET /_alias/{name}.

tools.name: elasticsearch_list_data_streams
tools.description: List data streams with their backing indices, generation, and status. API: GET /_data_stream or GET /_data_stream/{name}.

tools.name: elasticsearch_search
tools.description: Search documents in one or more indices with a Query DSL object. Returns hits, total count, and optional aggregations. Use elasticsearch_get_mapping first to learn the field names. API: POST /{index}/_search.

tools.name: elasticsearch_count
tools.description: Count the documents that match a Query DSL object in one or more indices. API: POST /{index}/_count.

tools.name: elasticsearch_get_document
tools.description: Get one document by index and id. Optional source_fields limits the returned fields. API: GET /{index}/_doc/{id}.

tools.name: elasticsearch_esql_query
tools.description: Run a read-only ES|QL query, e.g. 'FROM logs-* | WHERE status >= 500 | STATS count = COUNT(*) BY service | LIMIT 20'. Returns columns and rows. API: POST /_query.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: elasticsearch_search, elasticsearch_esql_query · Private data: elasticsearch_cluster_stats, elasticsearch_list_indices, elasticsearch_search, elasticsearch_count, elasticsearch_get_document · Public sink: elasticsearch_search, elasticsearch_count, elasticsearch_esql_query · Destructive: elasticsearch_list_nodes, elasticsearch_list_indices, elasticsearch_esql_query.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: elasticsearch_search, elasticsearch_esql_query · Private data: elasticsearch_cluster_stats, elasticsearch_list_indices, elasticsearch_search, elasticsearch_count, elasticsearch_get_document · Public sink: elasticsearch_search, elasticsearch_count, elasticsearch_esql_query · Destructive: elasticsearch_list_nodes, elasticsearch_list_indices, elasticsearch_esql_query

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
